description: Start durable funding to a currently certified venue and return immediately with an operation_id. Derive/options funding is under release hold and must not be started. Prefer this for the certified crypto bridge; monitor get_money_operation while the owner-signed route settles.

auto_swap_native_usdc.description: Automatically convert only the native Polygon USDC needed for this operation. Defaults to true.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it for the exact operation.

minimum_receive_usd.description: Optional minimum final venue credit. The route fails closed before submission when its bounded quote cannot satisfy this floor.

resume_reconciliation.description: Resume only this exact previously reconciled workflow.

name: start_fund_market
